The People's Sin the Cause of Judgments: They at Last Own It Themselves: the Redeemer's Future Interposition in Their Extremity.</title> <div sID="gen16358" type="x-p"/> The reason why Jehovah does not deliver His people, notwithstanding their religious services (<reference osisRef="Isa.58.3">Is 58:3</reference>), is not want of power on His part, but because of their sins (<reference osisRef="Isa.59.1-Isa.59.8">Is 59:1-8</reference>); <reference osisRef="Isa.59.9-Isa.59.15">Is 59:9-15</reference> contain their confession; <reference osisRef="Isa.59.16-Isa.59.21">Is 59:16-21</reference>, the consequent promise of the Messiah.<div eID="gen16358" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16359" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9427"/><hi type="bold">1. hand ... shortened--</hi>(See on <reference osisRef="Isa.50.2">Is 50:2</reference>).<div eID="gen16359" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen16360" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">ear heavy--</hi>(<reference osisRef="Isa.6.10">Is 6:10</reference>). <div eID="gen16360" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: CHAPTER 59 Is 59:1-21 . The People's Sin the Cause of Judgments: They at Last Own It Themselves: the Redeemer's Future Interposition in Their Extremity. The reason why Jehovah does not deliver His people, notwithstanding their religious services ( Is 58:3 ), is not want of power on His part, but because of their sins ( Is 59:1-8 ); Is 59:9-15 contain their confession; Is 59:16-21 , the consequent promise of the Messiah. 1. hand ... shortened-- (See on Is 50:2 ). ear heavy-- ( Is 6:10 ).

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9443"/><div sID="gen16404" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9443"/>17. Messiah is represented as a warrior armed at all points, going forth to vindicate His people. Owing to the unity of Christ and His people, their armor is like His, except that they have no "garments of vengeance" (which is God's prerogative, <reference osisRef="Rom.12.19">Ro 12:19</reference>), or "cloak of zeal" (in the sense of judicial fury punishing the wicked; this zeal belongs properly to God, <reference osisRef="2Kgs.10.16">2Ki 10:16</reference>; <reference osisRef="Rom.10.2">Ro 10:2</reference>; <reference osisRef="Phil.3.6">Php 3:6</reference>; "zeal," in the sense of anxiety for the Lord's honor, they have, <reference osisRef="Num.25.11">Nu 25:11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Num.25.13">13</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.69.9">Psa 69:9</reference>; <reference osisRef="2Cor.7.11">2Co 7:11</reference>; <reference osisRef="2Cor.9.2">9:2</reference>); and for "salvation," which is of God alone (<reference osisRef="Ps.3.8">Psa 3:8</reference>), they have as their helmet, "the hope of salvation" (<reference osisRef="1Thess.5.8">1Th 5:8</reference>). The "helmet of salvation" is attributed to them (<reference osisRef="Eph.6.14">Ep 6:14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Eph.6.17">17</reference>) in a secondary sense; namely, derived from Him, and as yet only in hope, not fruition (<reference osisRef="Rom.8.24">Ro 8:24</reference>). The second coming here, as often, is included in this representation of Messiah. His "zeal" (<reference osisRef="John.2.15-John.2.17">Joh 2:15-17</reference>) at His first coming was but a type of His zeal and vengeance against the foes of God at His second coming (<reference osisRef="2Thess.1.8-2Thess.1.10">2Th 1:8-10</reference>; <reference osisRef="Rev.19.11-Rev.19.21">Re 19:11-21</reference>). <div eID="gen16404" type="x-p"/>

The "helmet of salvation" is attributed to them ( Ep 6:14 , 17 ) in a secondary sense; namely, derived from Him, and as yet only in hope, not fruition ( Ro 8:24 ). Thus Paul, by inspiration, supplements the sense from <reference osisRef="Ps.14.7">Psa 14:7</reference>: He was, and is come to Zion, first with redemption, being sprung as man out of Zion. The Septuagint translates "for the sake of Zion." navigation_sections.content_plain: CHAPTER 59 Is 59:1-21 . The People's Sin the Cause of Judgments: They at Last Own It Themselves: the Redeemer's Future Interposition in Their Extremity. The reason why Jehovah does not deliver His people, notwithstanding their religious services ( Is 58:3 ), is not want of power on His part, but because of their sins ( Is 59:1-8 ); Is 59:9-15 contain their confession; Is 59:16-21 , the consequent promise of the Messiah.
